facts.statement: Provider pump, loader accessor004fde20, then loader update00509190; frame cleanup follows.
For nonzero count call global virtual+18h, flag current front, then repeat Sleep100/pump/update while loader+14h remains nonzero, then tail globalvirtual+1Ch.
Entry flags only the current front. Initial retirement can expose an unflagged state0 job that submits later in the same update.
Two-name callback ignores both arguments; reobtains current loader and writes front state2. It owns no originating job.

State1 falls through with no retirement/advancement; initial stop cleanup only handles states0/2. Under these serialized paths front persists for its pending callback. No actual cross-thread race is demonstrated.
Raw continuation after _free clears the old front, shifts remaining pointers and decrements loader+14h; pseudocode early-return is false.
